integration.npcConditions: Exact uninjured walter-cryo actor in cryo only, actual observed displacement, grounded and empty hands, all eight frames decoded. Rendering cache never mutates simulation state.
integration.backgroundConditions: Opaque lake panorama in landing sky pass before original native foreground and gameplay geometry. Other new views remain catalogue only.

imageGeneration.phaseReassignment: The first phase03 attempt is used as07 after visual review of the actual support leg. The original prompt, rejection for03 and reassignment are retained.
imageGeneration.visualReview: Eight final Walter poses reviewed independently, including opposite contacts and passes, pelvis anchors, whole bodies and complete shoes. World and prop references reviewed before generation.
fidelityLimits: Native generated pixels and detailed references do not establish pixel-identical film fidelity.
Walter poses are generated adaptations using the preserved V011 identity/costume sprite, not film motion capture.
Phase04 stride is relatively broad; face, folds and contact trajectories vary slightly.
Small official storyboards constrain Shaw portrait evidence; full costume and cinema appearances remain open.
Production designs are kept distinct from final-film proof and runtime placement.
imageGeneration.independentWorldPropReview: Six world images, three props and the separate Shaw portrait reviewed independently against declared local references. Whole isolated ship/prop silhouettes fit. The Juggernaut panorama intentionally inherits the source crop of the wreck; it is not a whole-craft sprite. Fine hardware and terrain geometry remain reconstructed.
